caption:
The Messenger who grieves over your suffering

Allah describes His Messenger ﷺ as one from among us, grieved by our suffering, concerned for us, and gracious and merciful towards the believers. Begin your day by sending peace and blessings upon him.

Surah At-Tawba 9:128

Send peace and blessings on the Prophet ﷺ before your first task

#prophetmuhammad #loveforprophet #sunnahreminder #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
